It was co-released and distributed through Yep Roc Records, Elephant 6 and Redeye Distribution.

Beginning a prolific career as a child actor at the age of eight, Halpin is perhaps best known for his role as Sandy Ricks in the feature films "Flipper" and "Flipper's New Adventure", as well as for reprising his role for the television series adaptation, also titled "Flipper".
